title: Mega Millions winning numbers as jackpot climbs to $505M for Nov. 6

 Fernando Cervantes Jr. USA TODAY Updated Nov. 6, 2026, 11:18 p.m. ET Hear this story The Mega Millions jackpot has climbed to $505 million for the Friday, Nov. 6, drawing, with a cash option of $213.3 million.
 If someone wins Friday’s jackpot, the winner can choose between a one-time lump-sum payment or an annuity consisting of an immediate payment followed by annual payments that increase by 5% each year.
 The Mega Millions jackpot was last won July 28, when a Florida ticket hit an $800 million prize , with a cash value of $344.2 million. The winning ticket was sold at a Wawa in Bradenton.
 Here’s what to know about Friday night’s drawing.
 What are the winning Mega Millions numbers for Nov. 6, 2026?
 The winning numbers for Friday’s Mega Millions drawing are 27, 34, 44, 53, and 64 . The Mega Ball is 1. 
 USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors. When is the next Mega Millions drawing?
 The next Mega Millions drawing is scheduled for Tuesday, November 10, at 11 p.m. ET.
 How to play the Mega Millions
 Mega Millions tickets are sold at convenience stores, gas stations, grocery stores and other lottery retailers. Some states also allow online purchases.
 Players choose five white-ball numbers from 1 to 70 and one gold Mega Ball number from 1 to 24. Don't want to pick your own? Ask for a Quick Pick, and the numbers will be generated for you.
 Mega Millions tickets now come with a built-in multiplier that boosts non-jackpot prizes by two, three, four, five or 10 times. Previously, players had to pay extra to add the Megaplier option.
